hook.text: The average household receives over 40 pounds of junk mail per year. Most sits in piles for months.

buildup.text: Paper piles grow because we delay deciding: keep, act, or toss. Indecision is the real clutter.

discovery.text: Sort mail at the door: recycle immediately, act on today, or file in one slim folder for reference.

twist.text: Most documents you keep are available digitally. Bank statements, bills, and receipts live online now.

climax.text: Switch to paperless billing, scan important documents, and keep only legal originals in a fireproof box.

punchline.text: Decide at the door. Paper never piles up.

quiz.question: What is the main cause of paper clutter at home?
options: Delaying the decision to keep, act, or discard
